feed.title: Gen Digital submits preliminary offer to acquire GoDaddy in potential Valley mega-deal
feed.summary: Gen Digital, parent company of Norton, Avast, and LifeLock, has submitted a preliminary offer to acquire GoDaddy. feed.title: Analog Devices, AMD, KLA Corporation, Lam Research, and Marvell Technology Stocks Trade Up, What You Need To Know
